name: deploy_build
description: After the coding agent finishes editing source code, use this tool to build, test, checkpoint, and deploy the changes. This tool: (1) commits all changes to git, (2) runs cargo build --release, (3) runs cargo test, (4) creates a checkpoint of current binaries, (5) shows the diff to the user, (6) asks for confirmation, (7) deploys and restarts the component. Requires user confirmation before deployment.

component.description: Which component to build and deploy.
